verdict.rationale: The axis applies: three.js ships an editor and loaders, so project format and team tooling are fair questions to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents mergeable scenes, diffable text project formats, or built-in collaboration. The editor and GLTFLoader appear only as bare links, with no mention of version-control or multi-user behavior.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the project format and tooling play well with version control and multi-person teams — mergeable scenes, diffable text formats, or built-in collaboration
